setup.title: Initial setup
setup.intro: First deployment: create the global admin, first agent and first project (each step is skippable).
setup.step1Desc: Create the first global administrator. Required on first deployment; if an admin already exists (e.g. created via CLI), this step auto-forwards to sign in.
setup.step2Desc: Create the first agent entry and issue a one-time registration code and per-agent token. Run the registration command on the build machine.
setup.step3Desc: Create the first project (git/svn). Pipelines can be configured later on the project page.
setup.agentHint: You can skip this: create entries and registration codes later on the Agents page.
setup.credsOneTime: One-time credentials (shown in plain text only once)
setup.credsWarn: Save these now: the token and registration code are shown only once and can never be retrieved later.
setup.cmdNote: Run on the build machine; the registration code is one-time and valid for 24h. Replace 'server' in the command with the real address (defaults: gRPC 50051 / REST 8080).
setup.cliLabel: CLI equivalent (for headless/Docker; running it counts as setup complete):

projects.name: Project name
projects.testConnectionHint: Testing the connection never blocks saving (ADR-0016): click to verify URL+credentials reach the repo; on success the git default branch can be prefilled.
projects.branchPrefillHint: The git default branch can be prefilled via test connection (ls-remote --symref HEAD).
projects.scmCredHint: SCM credentials are encrypted at rest, never on the command line/URL; only needed for private https repos (ADR-0015/0016).
projects.scmUrlRequired: Please enter the repository URL first
projects.scmUrlInvalid: Repository URL must start with http:// or https://
projects.pipelineListDegraded: The pipeline-list endpoint is not shipped yet; pipelines are probed individually by known name (200 = exists, 404 = not configured, other failure = probe failed). Will switch to a real list once the endpoint ships.
projects.membersAdminOnly: Member management requires the project admin role
projects.membersReplaceHint: Saving replaces the whole member set: members not listed are removed (ADR-0014).
projects.scmCredentialHint: The project SCM credentials (project admin) are encrypted at rest and used for polling / test-connection probes; clearing both username and password removes them (ADR-0015/0016).
projects.credentialAdminOnly: Credential management requires the project admin role

queueReason.no_online_agent: Waiting for agent: no agent online
queueReason.no_slot: Waiting for agent: no free slot

overview.alertNoMatch: There are tasks with no matching agent
overview.alertDrainingIncompatible: There are draining or version-incompatible agents

agents.name: Agent name
agents.customLabelsHint: One key=value per line (AND-matched against job requirements together with system labels)
agents.credentialsOneTime: One-time credentials (shown in plain text only once)
agents.credentialsWarn: Save these now: the token and registration code are shown only once and can never be retrieved later.
agents.cmdNote: Run on the build machine; the registration code is one-time and valid for 24h. Replace 'server' in the command with the real address (defaults: gRPC 50051 / REST 8080).
agents.cleanupHint: Clearing a workspace never touches the cache directory (ADR-0011); each agent's workspace tree is independent. Commands are forwarded over the gRPC channel to the agent; an offline agent is not reached.
agents.wsCleanDone: Workspace cleanup command sent (fire-and-forget; agent has no ack)
agents.cacheKeyPlaceholder: key (empty = clear all; non-empty = full key across pipelines)
agents.cacheDeleteDone: Cache delete command sent (fire-and-forget; agent has no ack)

buildList.empty: No builds yet. Trigger the first build from the editor page.

buildDetail.notFound: Build not found, or project/pipeline not visible.
buildDetail.waitingMissingLabels: Waiting for a matching agent: missing label(s) {labels}
buildDetail.waitingDegraded: Could not read the pipeline definition; waiting-label state for queued jobs is not shown (degraded).
buildDetail.cancelConfirm: Cancel this build? Started jobs will be aborted (queued/running can be cancelled; accepted as 202).
buildDetail.rerunConfirm: Rerun this build? From scratch creates a new build number; from failed keeps the number with attempt+1 (only failed / cancelled / timeout terminal states).
buildDetail.deleteConfirm: Delete build #{number}? This immediately removes its logs and artifact files; the build record (status / number / duration) is kept permanently (ADR-0013).
buildDetail.rerunConflict: Cannot rerun from failed (409): only failed / cancelled / timeout terminal states can rerun.
buildDetail.noParams: This pipeline has no parameters; it will trigger on the default branch.

buildLog.title: Log
buildLog.degraded: The log stream endpoint is not delivered yet (SSE logs unavailable — degraded state).
buildLog.truncated: Log reached the {limit} limit; further output was dropped (truncation does not fail the build).

secrets.noProjects: No projects yet — secrets are scoped to a project; create one on the Projects page first.
secrets.name: Secret name
secrets.nameHint: Non-empty, letters/digits/underscore only (env-key charset). Writing an existing name overwrites it.
secrets.valuePlaceholder: Secret value (encrypted on write, never readable back)
secrets.valueHint: Write-only: no endpoint ever returns the value — confirm before overwriting.
secrets.discipline: Secrets are injected into job processes as env vars (by name); {interp} interpolation never resolves secret values (kept out of command strings/logs); a clash between a job env key and a secret name is rejected at pipeline save time.

upgrade.uploadHint: Filename follows ADR-0010 convention sisyphus-agent-VERSION-os-arch (suffix .tar.gz/.zip/.tar); the backend parses the version and target triple, validates the compat window (>= N-1 and <= server), and records sha256. Multiple packages = multiple uploads.
upgrade.commandsHint: Upgrade commands go over the gRPC channel; the agent self-drains -> downloads & verifies -> atomic swap -> restart (ADR-0017). Sent immediately when online; queued for resend on reconnect when offline.
upgrade.upgradeIssued: Upgrade command issued (package {package}): {issued} agent(s) issued, {skipped} skipped (already at target version)

users.title: Users
users.usernameHint: 1-64 chars, letters/digits or _ . -; trimmed before use.
users.adminToggleUnavailable: The endpoint to toggle an existing user's global-admin flag is not shipped yet — set it at creation time; for existing users it's shown as a read-only badge.

tokens.title: Personal access tokens
tokens.oneTime: One-time token (shown in plain text only once)
tokens.name: Token name
tokens.warn: Save this now: the full token is shown only once and can never be retrieved later.
tokens.expiresHint: Leave empty for no expiry; the expiry must be later than now.

editor.notFound: Pipeline not configured yet — start from an empty definition; saving creates it (first revision=1).
editor.conflict: Concurrent save conflict: you loaded revision {loaded}, but it was since saved by someone else up to revision {prev}; your save has overwritten it to revision {revision}. Reload to review their changes.
editor.projectNotFound: Project does not exist or is not visible (404).
editor.trackHint: Stages=columns, jobs=chips; layout is data-derived, not draggable. Click a chip to select and navigate the form on the right.
editor.trackEmpty: No stages yet — click “Add stage” to start.
editor.selectPrompt: Select a job in the track on the left to edit its attributes.
editor.labelsHint: One key=value per line (union with system labels for AND match)
editor.whenHint: Restricted expression: comparison, logical AND/OR, string equality, exists; SISY_WORKSPACE variable forbidden
editor.secretsHint: Reference project secrets by name (injected into the process env before the job runs); a name colliding with an env key fails validation on save
editor.cacheKeyHint: Supports variable interpolation; SISY_WORKSPACE variable forbidden
editor.cacheFiles: files (exact paths, no globs, one per line)
editor.paramsHint: Manual triggers may override defaults; required params must have a default and enum must list choices (ADR-0006).
editor.envTabHint: Injected into shell step process env; job-level env overrides pipeline-level of the same name (ADR-0006).

errors.network: Network request failed. Please check that the service is reachable.
